newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kanda Tsushin says faces suit by Canadian firms.
newsitem.headline: Kanda Tsushin says faces suit by Canadian firms.

text.p: Kanda Tsushin Kogyo Co Ltd said on Wednesday two Canadian firms had filed a suit against two firms, including Kanda Tsushin, and one individual seeking compensation in a communications equipment contract dispute.

The Japanese telephone manufacturer said in a statement that AVAR Communications Inc and Omega Digital Data Inc, both based in Ontario, filed the suit in late March seeking compensation of about C$300 million.
Kanda said that it had filed a suit against the two Canadian firms last December seeking compensation of C$116 million over a contract dispute.
